item.text: The current suite only checks one ordinary case, helper normalization, and truthiness for members—so it would miss incorrect member amounts, UK behavior, free-shipping boundaries, and unsupported countries. I’m expanding those assertions while leaving `src/shipping-fee.js` unchanged; `npm test` is already configured as the entry point.

I couldn’t modify the tests or run `npm test` because this workspace is enforced as read-only and command execution is blocked. The existing `package.json` already defines `"test": "node --test"`; no files were changed.
